description: Create a smart folder (filtered view) — a saved filter/workflow over the user's saved posts. 'name' is required; 'base_query' is the filter query that defines which posts belong; 'triage_buckets' are optional tabs/stages inside the folder. Returns the created folder (with its slug).

action.description: Optional action applied when moving a post into this tab.

filter.description: Filter query that defines the tab's posts.

name.description: Tab/stage name shown inside the folder.

name: create_smart_folder
